phase1_formula_and_parameter_freeze.numerator: mark_price_return_bps = (mark_price(T) - mark_price(T-W)) / mark_price(T-W) * 1e4, both prices via nearest-at-or-before lookup (never a future mark price)
phase1_formula_and_parameter_freeze.denominator: max(|signed_notional_w| / 1_000_000, FLOOR_USD_M); absolute value of signed_notional, per frozen contract text; NOT a signed denominator
phase1_formula_and_parameter_freeze.signed_notional_w: sum(taker_sign(trade) * notional(trade)) over trades in [T-W, T]
phase1_formula_and_parameter_freeze.units: bps of mark-price return per $1,000,000 of net signed aggressive notional
phase1_formula_and_parameter_freeze.sign_convention: is_buyer_maker=0 -> taker_sign=+1 (taker BUY); is_buyer_maker=1 -> taker_sign=-1 (taker SELL); identical to ami/cvd/windowed_taker_flow.py
phase1_formula_and_parameter_freeze.price_source: microstructure.db:mark_prices, nearest at-or-before convention identical to ami.states.engine.StateEngine._px
phase1_formula_and_parameter_freeze.signed_notional_source: microstructure.db:agg_trades (native), merged with data/ami/canonical.sqlite:ami_agg_trades_repaired where a window intersects one of its 8 repair spans (repaired row wins on content conflict for the same agg_trade_id); 0 of the 324 signals' windows intersected any repair span in this rehearsal
phase1_formula_and_parameter_freeze.anchor_timestamp: T = signal_birth_ts (from ami_signal_lifecycle, reused verbatim, no new identity)
phase1_formula_and_parameter_freeze.numerical_precision: IEEE-754 double (Python float) throughout; no intermediate rounding
phase1_formula_and_parameter_freeze.zero_denominator_policy: floored at FLOOR_USD_M, never divides by exactly zero, never crashes
phase1_formula_and_parameter_freeze.near_zero_denominator_policy: same floor applies continuously, no discontinuity beyond the floor itself
phase1_formula_and_parameter_freeze.source_gap_policy: CONFIRMED_GAP_OVERLAP -> immutable exclusion row, never imputed; UNRESOLVED_GAP_PROXIMITY and WINDOW_STARTS_BEFORE_COLLECTION_BEGAN reserved categories (0 occurrences today)
phase1_formula_and_parameter_freeze.duplicate_policy: dedup by agg_trade_id; native + repaired both present for same id -> repaired value wins (matches CVD repair precedent)

floor_usd_m.selected_outcome_blind_from: W=60 signed-notional distribution across all 324 signals (0 excluded at that window): min=$37,006.70, p1=$93,985.10, max=$78,936,758.21
floor_usd_m.derivation_rule: 1st percentile of |signed_notional| at W=60s, rounded down to one significant figure, expressed in $M units

phase1_formula_and_parameter_freeze.formula_or_alteration_this_batch: none -- no upgrade, no alternative formula, no window/floor change performed or proposed

hash_type_definitions.raw_file_byte_hash: sha256 over the literal bytes of a retained disposable file; differs run-to-run for the two .sqlite files because row-level created_ms/assessed_at_ms bookkeeping timestamps capture each run's wall-clock time
hash_type_definitions.deterministic_scientific_content_hash: sha256 over a table's declared content columns only (all columns except the bookkeeping timestamp columns), ORDER BY 1, joined and hashed; reproducible byte-for-byte across independent reruns against the same frozen source state
hash_type_definitions.semantic_hash_excluding_non_scientific_b: identical computation and identical result to the deterministic scientific-content hash above -- in this rehearsal there is no other volatile-but-non-bookkeeping field, so these two categories collapse to one value per table; kept as two named concepts here only because the freeze instructions distinguish them

fields_excluded_from_semantic_hashing.justification: wall-clock time this specific disposable row was inserted; carries no information about the measured signed_notional/mark_return/price_response values; two runs against identical frozen source state legitimately differ here while being scientifically identical

wall-clock time the quality classification was assessed; the classification result itself (quality_status, gap flags) is a separate, included column; identical convention to ami/warehouse/experiment_ledger.py's _VOLATILE_BOOKKEEPING_COLUMNS
same as above; the exclusion reason_code itself is included and hashed

tables.name: absorption_impact_windowed_flow (canonical, illustrative-alias ami_impact_windowed_flow)
tables.purpose: one row per usable (signal, window) pair: the constructed price_response_per_signed_notional feature and its inputs
tables.columns_and_units: feature_id TEXT, feature_definition_version TEXT, signal_id TEXT, source_event_id TEXT, independent_cycle_id TEXT, symbol TEXT, direction TEXT, signal_birth_ts INTEGER (ms), window_id TEXT, window_start_ts_ms INTEGER, window_end_ts_ms INTEGER, trade_count INTEGER, native_rows_used INTEGER, repaired_rows_used INTEGER, signed_notional REAL (USD), total_notional REAL (USD), mark_price_start REAL, mark_price_end REAL, mark_return_bps REAL, floor_usd_m_applied INTEGER (bool), floor_usd_m_value REAL, price_response_per_signed_notional REAL (bps per $1M), evidence_layer TEXT, feature_available_ts_ms INTEGER, known_at_classification TEXT, created_ms INTEGER
tables.evidence_layer_checks: CHECK (evidence_layer='EXACT'); no proxy row may ever exist in this table
tables.foreign_keys: signal_id -> ami_signal_lifecycle.signal_id (logical; not enforced at rehearsal stage, should be enforced or at least verified at migration time)
tables.immutable_update_policy: insert-only; a corrected computation requires a new feature_definition_version, never an UPDATE of an existing row
tables.idempotent_insert_behavior: INSERT OR IGNORE on the UNIQUE constraint; a second migration run must be a no-op (0 new rows, 0 changed rows)

tables.name: absorption_impact_window_quality_v1 (canonical, illustrative-alias ami_impact_window_quality_v1)
tables.purpose: exactly one quality-classification row per (signal, window) pair regardless of usability
tables.columns_and_units: quality_id TEXT, quality_contract_version TEXT, signal_id TEXT, symbol TEXT, window_id TEXT, window_start_ts_ms INTEGER, window_end_ts_ms INTEGER, evidence_layer TEXT, quality_status TEXT, confirmed_gap_overlap INTEGER (bool), unresolved_gap_overlap INTEGER (bool), before_collection_began INTEGER (bool), repaired_rows_used INTEGER, native_rows_used INTEGER, assessed_at_ms INTEGER
tables.immutable_update_policy: insert-only per quality_contract_version; disclosed gap vs. CVD's full cadence-proof machinery -- this rehearsal's classify_quality() is a conservative gap-ledger-only approximation (see remaining risk #1 in the rehearsal report), an open item for A5 to resolve, not silently upgraded here
tables.idempotent_insert_behavior: INSERT OR IGNORE; second run is a no-op

tables.name: absorption_impact_exclusions (canonical, illustrative-alias ami_impact_exclusions)
tables.purpose: immutable exclusion ledger; one row per (signal, window) pair that could not be constructed
tables.columns_and_units: exclusion_id TEXT, signal_id TEXT, symbol TEXT, window_id TEXT, reason_code TEXT, created_ms INTEGER
tables.evidence_layer_checks: n/a (no evidence_layer column; exclusions are pre-evidence)
tables.immutable_update_policy: insert-only; a signal/window pair excluded for a gap must never be silently repaired into this same row -- a repair would require a new reason-code-absent feature row plus retention of this exclusion row for audit history, or an explicit superseding decision at A5
tables.idempotent_insert_behavior: INSERT OR IGNORE; second run is a no-op
